records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue increased by $19.6 million, or 12.9%, to $172.3 million for the three months ended July 1, 2022, from $152.6 million for the three months ended July 2, 2021, and our revenue increased by $45.3 million, or 10.0%, to $497.0 million for the nine months ended July 1, 2022, from $451.7 million for the nine months ended July 2, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Given the significant continued economic uncertainty and volatility created by the pandemic, it is difficult to predict the nature and extent of impacts on the demand for our products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, cash used in operating assets and liabilities was $45.3 million for the nine months ended July 1, 2022, primarily driven by an increase in accounts receivable of $22.0 million, an increase in inventories of $27.5 million and a decrease of $12.7 million in accrued and other liabilities, partially offset by an increase in accounts payable of $14.1 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 60.7% and 57.2% for the three months ended July 1, 2022 and July 2, 2021, respectively, and 59.9% and 55.7% for the nine months ended July 1, 2022 and July 2, 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjustments to reconcile our net income to cash provided by operating activities primarily included a net gain of $114.9 million related to the sale of our equity method investment offset by equity method investment losses, depreciation and intangible amortization expense of $43.1 million and share-based compensation expense of $30.3 million.
